title: Terraform custom and predefined URL category resources
aliases: delete url category still in use terraform

checks.do: Whether a DLP rule references the category by `val` rather than by name.
Whether an import of a predefined category lists every custom item the HCL should keep before the next apply.
Which custom category cap applies to the tenant, since the provider docs and the help page differ.

url-order-diff-suppressed.statement: Provider v4.7.23 fixed `zia_url_categories` planning failing after import, or whenever the API returned `urls` in a different order from the HCL, and re-ordering URLs in the configuration produces no diff.

quotes: or any time the API returned the `urls` list in a different order than the one declared in HCL
re-ordering URLs in the configuration continues to produce no diff

val-for-dlp-reference.statement: The numeric `val` attribute is the category's unique ID and the one to use when referencing the category in other resources such as DLP web rules.

quotes: The unique ID for the URL category. This attribute is particularly useful when referencing the URL category in other resources like DLP web rules.

tf-limit-48-custom.statement: The provider documentation says up to 48 custom URL categories can be added per organization.

quotes: Up to 48 custom URL categories can be added per organization.

import-custom-only.statement: `zia_url_categories` imports only custom categories, by category ID or name; built-in categories cannot be imported.

quotes: This provider only supports the importing of custom URL categories. The importing of built-in categories is not supported.

delete-detaches-v4-7-26.statement: From provider v4.7.26 deleting a custom URL category first detaches it from every rule that references it, avoiding the API error for a category still in use.

quotes: now automatically detaches a custom URL category from any rules that reference it before deleting the category.

predefined-incremental.statement: `zia_url_categories_predefined` changes predefined categories with incremental `ADD_TO_LIST` and `REMOVE_FROM_LIST` operations for its list fields rather than replacing the category.

quotes: The provider uses incremental `ADD_TO_LIST` and `REMOVE_FROM_LIST` API operations for all list fields

predefined-description-drift.statement: The `description` attribute is not supported on predefined categories because the API accepts it in the PUT but does not return it in the GET, which would cause persistent drift.

quotes: the value is not returned in the GET response for predefined categories, which would cause persistent state drift.

predefined-import-captures-existing.statement: Importing a predefined category that already has custom URLs, keywords or IP ranges captures them in state, and the next apply removes any that the HCL omits.

quotes: those existing items will be captured in the Terraform state.

predefined-import-only.statement: `zia_url_categories_predefined` imports only predefined categories, by category ID or display name; custom categories use `zia_url_categories`.

quotes: This resource only supports importing **predefined** URL categories.

custom-category-cap-48-vs-64.summary: How many custom URL categories a tenant can hold by default.

positions.says: The Terraform resource documentation says up to 48 custom URL categories per organization.

quotes: Up to 48 custom URL categories can be added per organization.

positions.says: The Ranges and Limitations help page gives 64 as the default limit for custom categories.

quotes: The default limit for custom categories is 64.

custom-category-cap-48-vs-64.impact: Do not quote 48 as the tenant limit from the provider docs alone; the help page figure is 64, raisable through Support, and which is current for a given tenant is not settled here.

large-category-plan-time.title: How long a plan or refresh takes for a custom category with tens of thousands of URLs
large-category-plan-time.blocks: saying that planning a large custom URL category is slow or fast
large-category-plan-time.detail: Unverified legacy statement: upstream issue 575 reported a roughly 20,000 URL category taking about 18 minutes during plan and refresh, and v4.7.22 introducing a `SetNew only operates on computed keys` failure that v4.7.23 fixed. Neither figure is in the vendored changelog; time a plan on a category of that size.
